LanguageData.OTS.BindDesc: Bind this mechanitor ship to a mechanitor. This ship gives the mechanitor {0} bandwidth and serves as a base station with extra command range, so the mechanitor can command mechanoids around the ship. If the ship is unbound, it needs {1} to reset. During that time, the ship cannot be used and cannot be bound.
LanguageData.OTS.NoMechanitor: No mechanitor is available to bind.
LanguageData.OTS.Rebinding: This ship is rebinding to {0}. {1} remaining.
LanguageData.OTS.Resetting: The binding is cleared. This ship can be bound again in {0}.
LanguageData.OTS.RebindWait: This ship can be bound again in {0}. Until then, it cannot launch and it cannot be bound.
LanguageData.OTS.NeedMechanitorAboard: This mechanitor ship needs a mechanitor or a mechanoid aboard before it can launch.
LanguageData.OTS.DroneReturning: The transport drone has set down its cargo and is returning.
LanguageData.OTS.DroneLowFuel: There is not enough chemfuel for the return trip. The transport drone is still returning.
LanguageData.OTS.MechShuttleLowFuel: There is not enough chemfuel for the return trip. The mechanitor ship is still returning.
LanguageData.OTS.MechShuttleAbortOption: This destination cannot take a delivery. The mechanitor ship will return with the mechanoids and the cargo.
LanguageData.OTS.MechShuttleReturningWithCargo: The delivery failed. The mechanitor ship is returning with the mechanoids and the cargo.
LanguageData.OTS.MechShuttleReturnedWithCargo: The mechanitor ship has returned with the mechanoids and the cargo.
LanguageData.OTS.MechShuttleLowFuelCargo: There is not enough chemfuel for the return trip. The mechanitor ship is still returning with the mechanoids and the cargo.
LanguageData.OTS.ShuttleScrapped:
You win. The destination you picked is so peculiar and outrageous that your shuttle is too ashamed to land.
Your shuttle has now broken apart. Its raw materials and everything it carried will be airdropped at the destination.
LanguageData.OTS.BindLimit: A mechanitor can bind at most {0} mechanitor ships.
